summary: Iter50 verified Informasi Legal (Kebijakan Privasi / Syarat dan Ketentuan / Pedoman Program) feature end-to-end. Backend pytest 5/5 pass in test_legal_information.py: public GET /api/site/content exposes site content, PUT /api/site/content requires auth (401/403 unauth, 403 student), super_admin can save legal_information and GET reflects saved values, restore path verified. Frontend: footer links on Landing point to /privacy-policy, /syarat-ketentuan, /pedoman-program; each route renders <h1> = section title and data-testid="legal-page-content" from api/site/content with sensible defaults when legal_information absent; no horizontal overflow at 390px width. Super Admin login -> Kelola Website -> Informasi Legal tab renders 3 title inputs + 3 textareas + data-testid=save-legal-information button; edits saved via UI and immediately visible on public /privacy-policy, /syarat-ketentuan, /pedoman-program (round trip confirmed). site_content.legal_information restored (unset) to its pre-test original state.
critical_code_review_comments: LegalInformationPage.jsx L14-18: useEffect calls api.get('/site/content') on every mount for each of 3 static pages; consider a lightweight cache or Context so navigating between the three legal pages does not refetch the entire site_content payload each time.

LegalInformationPage.jsx L26: content is rendered as plain whitespace-pre-wrap text; if BAZNAS legal team wants headings/lists/links, this will not render markdown/HTML. Consider adding markdown rendering (react-markdown) or a rich text editor in SiteManager LegalEditor to match production expectations for legal pages.

SiteManager.jsx L233-244 (LegalEditor): initial state is derived once from props via useState; if a super_admin switches tabs after loading, unsaved values may not update if the parent re-fetches c.legal_information. Consider syncing state with a useEffect on the content prop, or lifting state to parent SiteManager for consistency with other editors.

server.py PUT /api/site/content accepts any dict under 'content' with no schema for legal_information (SiteContentInput.content: Dict[str, Any]). A malformed payload can shape-break the public page (e.g. {legal_information: 'string'}). Consider a Pydantic sub-model {privacy, terms, guide: {title:str, content:str}} for defense in depth.

Landing.jsx footer uses <Link to> which is correct for SPA nav; ensure that if these routes are opened in a new tab (target=_blank not set), SEO crawlers can still index /privacy-policy — currently they can only via SPA render (fine for MVP, but not ideal for legal pages).
seed_data_creation: None. site_content.legal_information was set during the test then $unset to restore pre-test state (feature is brand new so field did not exist originally). Verified GET /api/site/content no longer returns legal_information key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_legal_information.py is the regression suite for Informasi Legal CMS. It captures original legal_information via module-scoped fixture and restores at teardown. If the field is deliberately populated in future by main agent, update the fixture accordingly. Frontend UI wiring: SiteManager tab 'legal' -> LegalEditor (data-testid=save-legal-information); public pages have data-testid=legal-page-{privacy|terms|guide} with content at data-testid=legal-page-content.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria met.
